title: NSClient V3, AAPS Full, Client1 and Client2; Websockets are disconnected on startup and restart of AAPS 3.3.3.0 -dev b
symptom: Websockets are disconnected on startup or restart of the app, affecting AAPS Full, Client1, and Client2 versions 3.3.3.0-dev b. This results in inability to set TTs, treatments, or profile changes via client. The issue occurs daily and is critical in a parental setup.
fix: The thread references a commit (fdd17476faa173d49d1a1ffe0306d613765ba45a) which likely contains the fix, but the thread does not describe the specific action or setting.
evidence_quote: Websockets are disconnected on startup or restart of App.
